metadata.name: Character Enhance
metadata.description:
[h1]Character Enhance[/h1] Independently configurable enhancements for Tainted Lost, Tainted Eden, Bethany, Esau Jr., and familiar-capacity protection. Requires Repentance; REPENTOGON is not required.
[h1]角色增强[/h1] 为里游魂、里伊甸、伯大尼、小以扫及跟班容量保护提供可独立开关的增强功能。需要 Repentance，不需要 REPENTOGON。
Supports English and Simplified Chinese Mod Config Menu labels. / 支持英文与简体中文 Mod Config Menu。
